common.fallback: Burauzarka ba ta tallafa wa bidiyon da aka saka ba.

motionBlur.title: Yadda ake ƙara dishewar motsi a bidiyo a iPhone kyauta
motionBlur.description: Kalli kwatancen dishewar motsi na ByteWave, sannan ka shafa tasirin a iPhone ka zaɓi ƙarfinsa.
motionBlur.intro: Buɗe Advanced → Motion Blur a ByteWave, zaɓi ƙarfi ka taɓa Apply. Kalli kwatancen tashar jirgin ruwa ka gwada matakan a bidiyonka.
motionBlur.aria: Kwatancen dishewar motsi: tashar jirgin ruwa ta asali a hagu, dishewar motsi ta ByteWave a dama
motionBlur.caption: Yanayin tashar jirgin ruwa ɗaya yana kunnawa a rabin biyu na sakan 19.5, na asali a hagu, dishewar motsi a dama. Babu sauti.
motionBlur.observe: Kalli gefunan kwale-kwalen da ke motsi, dogayen sandunansu da bakin ruwa. Dishewa tana laushin bayanai tare da motsi. Kunna ka dakatar don kwatanta firam ɗaya-ɗaya.
motionBlur.step1: Buɗe bidiyonka. Ƙara guntun bidiyo da Add Media idan ana buƙata, sannan ka zaɓi ƙaramin hotonsa.
motionBlur.step2: Buɗe kayan gyara. Taɓa maɓalli mai kusurwa shida kusa da samfoti ka zaɓi Advanced.
motionBlur.step3: Zaɓi Motion Blur. Zaɓi tayal ɗin Motion Blur mai ruwan hoda a Advanced.
motionBlur.step4: Saita ƙarfi ka shafa. Matsar da slider daga 1 zuwa 100 ka taɓa Apply.
motionBlur.step5: Jira sarrafawa, sannan ka kunna guntun bidiyon don duba tasirin a duk motsinsa.
motionBlur.exportNote: Don ajiye sakamakon, buɗe menu na kayan aiki ka zaɓi Export.
motionBlur.strength1: Fara da ƙaramin ƙima don kiyaye bayanai. Ƙara shi ka duba a gudun da kake shirin fitarwa da shi.
motionBlur.strength2: Motsin kamara na iya laushin yawancin firam. Idan ya yi kamar ya shafe sosai, yi amfani da ƙaramin ƙima a sabon kwafin bidiyon asali.
motionBlur.differenceTitle: Dishewar motsi da motsi a hankali suna ayyuka daban
motionBlur.differenceText: Dishewar motsi tana laushin motsi cikin kowane hoto; motsi a hankali yana sauya gudun kunnawa. Don sauya gudu, karanta
motionBlur.freeTitle: Gyara kyauta ba tare da tilasta asusu ba
motionBlur.privacyText: Dishewar motsi kyauta ce a ByteWave, babu alamar ruwa a fitarwa ko tilasta asusu. Editan kan na'ura ba ya ɗora bidiyo a uwar garken ByteWave; wallafawa a intanet ta zaɓi tana da dokokinta a
motionBlur.cta: Gwada da bidiyoyinka. Shafa dishewar motsi ka kwatanta sakamakon kafin fitarwa.

frameRate.title: Sauya yawan firam don bidiyon motsi a hankali a iPhone
frameRate.description: Kalli motsi a hankali na yau da kullum na 0.1× kusa da sauya yawan firam na ByteWave ka koyi amfani da FRC.
frameRate.intro: Sauya yawan firam (FRC) yana ƙara firam a tsakiya don sa motsi a hankali ya yi santsi. Nemo shi a ƙarƙashin Speed a ByteWave.
frameRate.left: Rage gudu na yau da kullum · 0.1×
frameRate.aria: Hummingbird a 0.1×: rage gudu na yau da kullum a hagu, sauya yawan firam na ByteWave a dama
frameRate.caption: Ɗaukar hummingbird ta sakan uku ɗaya, an rage zuwa 0.1× a rabin biyu; rage gudu na yau da kullum a hagu, ByteWave FRC a dama. Babu sauti.
frameRate.stepsTitle: Yadda ake amfani da sauya yawan firam
frameRate.step1: Zaɓi bidiyonka ka zaɓi Speed daga babban menu na gyara.
frameRate.step2: Zaɓi gudun kunnawa; kunna FRC don motsi a hankali mai santsi da Reverse don kunnawa da baya. Wannan misalin yana amfani da gudun 0.1× da FRC na 8×.
frameRate.step3: Sarrafawa ka duba samfotin motsin kafin fitarwa.
frameRate.warp: Idan gefunan da ke motsi da sauri sun lanƙwashe ko shafe, gwada rage gudu da ba shi da tsanani sosai.
frameRate.relatedIntro: Don wata hanyar laushin motsi, duba
frameRate.cta: Ƙirƙiri bidiyon motsi a hankali naka a ByteWave.

temporalNoise.title: Rage ƙurar hoto ta firam masu jere a bidiyo a iPhone
temporalNoise.description: Kwatanta bidiyon misalin Apple na asali da rage ƙurar hoto ta firam masu jere na ByteWave, har da hatsi da gefunan da ke motsi.
temporalNoise.intro: Rage ƙurar hoto ta firam masu jere yana haɗa bayanai daga firam na kusa don rage hatsi a bidiyo. Nemo Advanced → Temporal Noise Reduction a kayan guntun bidiyo na ByteWave.
temporalNoise.comparisonTitle: Rage ƙurar hoto ta firam masu jere kafin da bayan
temporalNoise.aria: Kwatancen ganyen Apple: na asali a hagu, rage ƙurar hoto na ByteWave a dama
temporalNoise.caption: Bidiyon misalin Apple, na asali a hagu da rage ƙurar hoto na ByteWave a dama, suna kunnawa tare a gudun al'ada ba tare da sauti ba.
temporalNoise.stepsTitle: Yadda ake rage ƙurar hoto a bidiyo
temporalNoise.step1: Zaɓi guntun bidiyon ka buɗe kayan gyaransa.
temporalNoise.step2: Buɗe Advanced → Temporal Noise Reduction ka shafa tasirin.
temporalNoise.step3: Duba sakamakon, sannan ka fitar idan ka gamsu.
temporalNoise.lookFor: Kwatanta hatsi a wurare masu duhu; duba cewa ganye da rassan sun riƙe bayanansu kuma gefunan da ke motsi ba sa barin sawu. Kunnawa a cikakken allo yana taimakawa ganin ƙananan bambance-bambance.
temporalNoise.frcLink: motsi a hankali da sauya yawan firam
temporalNoise.cta: Gwada rage ƙurar hoto ta firam masu jere a bidiyoyinka.
